name: dokploy-dev
description: Dokploy self-hosted PaaS development plugin (aligned with Dokploy v0.29.5). Deploy applications, provision 6 database types (Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Redis, LibSQL), manage domains and Docker Compose stacks, AND debug failed deployments end-to-end — reads runtime logs of every container (including each container in a Docker Compose stack) over the API/MCP with tail/since/search, plus AI-powered log analysis (ai-analyzeLogs), Docker container introspection, Traefik diagnosis, and a guided recovery chain. Uses the official @dokploy/mcp server (500+ tools across 49 categories) plus debugging-focused slash commands including /compose-logs.
